mission: Keep excitatory glutamate and inhibitory GABA signalling matched so neural networks operate with stability.

decisions.biological_role: PLP is required by GAD for endogenous GABA synthesis, supporting the inhibitory signalling capacity on which PM8 depends.
decisions.limitations: An intracellular cofactor requirement; PLP is formed from B6 vitamers. This does not establish a need to ingest PLP itself, additional-intake benefit or corrected E/I balance.

decisions.biological_role: B6 vitamers provide precursors for PLP, supporting GAD-dependent GABA synthesis within the endogenous inhibitory arm.
decisions.limitations: Supported capacity/provision chain, not proof that extra B6 improves signalling balance in adequately supplied people. Deficiency findings are age/model dependent; PLP is not GABA-specific.

decisions.biological_role: Intracellular glutamate is the immediate GAD substrate for GABA synthesis and the transmitter used by the excitatory arm.
decisions.limitations: Endogenous synthesis, neuronal uptake and recycling contribute. This does not establish a requirement to consume glutamate, MSG or a separate protein delivery category.

decisions.biological_role: Astrocytic glutamine supplies neuronal glutamate and can sustain activity-dependent vesicular GABA release through the glutamate–GABA–glutamine cycle.
decisions.limitations: Endogenous, compartment-specific recycling; experimental bath rescue is not oral supplementation efficacy, an indispensable dietary glutamine requirement or universal dependence of resting transmission.

decisions.biological_role: Riboflavin is converted to FMN, enabling PNPO-dependent conversion of pyridoxine/pyridoxamine phosphates to PLP for the endogenous GABA-synthesis supply route.
decisions.limitations: Conditional provision route: direct pyridoxal phosphorylation bypasses PNPO. No B2 intake threshold, ordinary-status limitation or improvement of E/I balance from additional intake is established.

decisions.rationale: Biomarker/receptor results do not establish the target PM governed matched E/I state for Direct requirement admission; separately qualified bounded experimental intervention.
decisions.limitations: Mouse gavage and a regional ELISA endpoint; not microbial GABA tracing, a dietary necessity, demonstrated circuit balance, ordinary-food equivalence or human benefit.

decisions.rationale: Biomarker/receptor results do not establish the target PM governed matched E/I state for Direct requirement admission; separately qualified bounded experimental intervention.
decisions.limitations: Strain-specific mouse effects; bacterial GABA mediation and synaptic E/I correction were not isolated. A healthy-male human trial did not improve assessed stress, cognitive or EEG outcomes.

kc_reviews.applicability_proposition: The current BRS1(KC1) monoamine-precursor LNAA competitive pool constrains PM8 endogenous GABA/glutamate signalling capacity.
established_links: Current KC constituents are tryptophan, tyrosine and phenylalanine in the monoamine LAT1 competitive pool; the broad IAA-quality construct is excluded by the KC record.
GAD uses neuronal glutamate and PLP; activity-dependent inhibitory supply uses astrocyte–neuron glutamine recycling (PM8-F11/F12).
inferred_links: A separate monoamine-to-PM8 constraint route would need evidence; amino-acid naming or general protein quality does not establish it.
kc_reviews.rationale: The current KC definition no longer includes the historical broad IAA-quality construct. No mapping is admitted: a monoamine-pool inadequacy/imbalance-to-PM8 capacity constraint remains unestablished and requires a separate supported chain. The missing link is not proof that monoamines never influence E/I circuits. Historical unresolved identity is retained in the audit; no canonical iKC was invented.

kc_reviews.applicability_proposition: Imbalance of LAT1 competitive large-neutral-amino-acid balance can constrain this mechanism’s governed excitation–inhibition capacity.
established_links: Network E/I balance is a circuit property once transmitters are in place (PM8-F1).
Fernstrom 2013’s LAT1 cargo set is large neutral amino acids, not glutamate or GABA.
inferred_links: LAT1 imbalance would change amino-acid presentation and thereby constrain E/I capacity.
kc_reviews.rationale: The named competitive state is LAT1 LNAA balance. Glutamate and GABA are not that cargo set. Delivery inference does not apply this arm to E/I capacity.
